title: AWS App Runner
description: Deploy containerized web applications and APIs at scale with AWS App Runner, including source and container deployment options.

data.text: AWS App Runner is the simplest way to deploy containerized web applications and APIs. You can deploy from a source code repository (GitHub) or from an existing container image in ECR. App Runner handles provisioning, scaling, load balancing, and security automatically.

With source deployment, you connect your GitHub repository and App Runner builds and deploys the container automatically. With container deployment, you point to an existing ECR image and App Runner deploys it. Both options support automatic deployments on code changes.

App Runner automatically scales your application from zero to many instances based on incoming requests. When there are no requests, instances scale down to zero. When traffic arrives, App Runner spins up new instances in seconds.

By default, App Runner services are publicly accessible. You can configure VPC connectivity so your App Runner service can privately access resources like RDS databases or ElastiCache clusters inside your VPC without exposing them to the internet.

data.title: App Runner Key Features
items: Automatic scaling from zero to many instances
Built-in HTTPS with custom domain support
Automatic deployments from source or container image
Pay per use with no minimums

data.title: When to Use App Runner
data.text: App Runner is perfect for simple web apps, APIs, and microservices where you want to deploy quickly without managing ECS or Kubernetes. It is the fastest path from code to production on AWS.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: App Runner deploys containers from source or ECR with zero infrastructure to manage
Automatic scaling from zero keeps costs low
VPC connectivity lets App Runner access private resources
App Runner is the simplest AWS container deployment option
data.takeaway: If you want to deploy a containerized web app without learning ECS or Kubernetes, App Runner is the answer.
